Let $A_i$ be the area of the $i$-th layer of the sandcastle, where $i=1$ is the bottom layer and $i=782$ is the top layer.
We are given that the area of each layer is half the area of the layer below it. This means that $A_i = \frac{1}{2} A_{i-1}$ for $i > 1$.
We are also given that the top layer has an area of 719, so $A_{782} = 719$.
We want to find the average area of a layer, which is $\frac{1}{782} \sum_{i=1}^{782} A_i$.
Since $A_i = \frac{1}{2} A_{i-1}$, we have $A_i = \frac{1}{2^{i-1}} A_1$.
We know that $A_{782} = 719$, so $719 = \frac{1}{2^{782-1}} A_1 = \frac{1}{2^{781}} A_1$.

The sum of the areas of all layers is
$$ \sum_{i=1}^{782} A_i = \sum_{i=1}^{782} \frac{1}{2^{i-1}} A_1 = A_1 \sum_{i=1}^{782} \frac{1}{2^{i-1}} = A_1 \sum_{i=0}^{781} \frac{1}{2^i} $$
